cli.critical_failure: CI/CD Failure: Critical regulatory violations found.
cli.noscript_coverage: Content available without JavaScript: {percent}% ({without} of {with} characters)
cli.noscript_empty: The page is effectively empty without JavaScript.
cli.noscript_partial: A substantial part of the content is missing without JavaScript.
cli.noscript_ok: Core content is available without JavaScript.
cli.noscript_impact: This rarely affects the people who turned JavaScript off, but the people whose scripts never arrived: a weak mobile network, a corporate proxy, a browser extension that misbehaves, a timeout. They get an empty page instead of a slow one.
cli.noscript_advisory: Recommendation, not a legal requirement. No WCAG success criterion requires a page to work without JavaScript, so this does not affect the compliance score.
cli.badge_withheld: 100/100 with no findings. The robustness check is not clean, so we do not generate a shareable badge.

plain.closing: Start at the top. The items highest up cost you the most customers.
